name: Extract leads (bulk)
summary: Export a large set of leads to a CSV/TSV/SSV file. Pick the fields, choose one filter (static/smart list or a date range), start the job, then download the file when it finishes.
whenToUse: You need more than 1,000 leads, or a one-off export of a whole list/date range. Normal 'Get leads' calls stop at 1,000 matches (error 1003).
notes: Jobs run asynchronously — the file is usually ready within minutes. You can keep using the app; check back in Job history.
Date-range filters must span 31 days or fewer.
updatedAt and smart-list filters may be unavailable on some subscriptions (error 1035 if yours is).
Export files are kept by Marketo for 10 days.
Marketo runs at most 2 bulk jobs at a time (10 in the queue) — error 1016 means the queue is full; wait and retry.
Empty values come back as null in the file.
